items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: Oh, Lady Wilcar? Yeah. ... INTERVIEWEE: What do I know about her (chuckle)? Lady Wilcar? She could play a piano, man.

ctx.x: later on, I know you remember this lady who was an excellent pianist who used to work with quite a few bands. Lady Wilcar(phonetic).
Lady Wilcar used for us when we started playin' with you, with Al Adams and George Brown and--
